to: A red-on-purpose suite gives the next hand no way to tell whose failure it is

Red attribution is DERIVED from git at run time, never declared: a `known_red:` list in config.yaml is a versioned copy of what commit titles already say and goes stale silently, and a flag on a `verification:` entry is per-task so it cannot speak about somebody else's red. A new command `branchling red` reads the existing file-to-task index (scripts/modified-files.mjs), rather than `check --red-owners`: a contract here runs `check`, so a `check` that ran the suite would call itself.
